stories.title: Kabine sonrası kritik fon açıklaması! Erdoğan tarih verdi

en.title: Critical fund announcement after cabinet! Erdoğan gives date
en.summary: President Erdoğan made statements following a cabinet meeting regarding a fund crisis, providing a timeline for resolution in October.

stories.title: Erdoğan'dan Kabine sonrası açıklamalar: 'Türkiye'de şahsım dahil kimse eleştirilemez değildir’

en.title: Erdoğan after cabinet meeting: 'No one in Turkey, including myself, is beyond criticism'
en.summary: President Erdoğan stated that 282 people faced legal proceedings and 84 were detained in a fund investigation, noting principal payments up to 1 million lira would be made once legislation passes parliament.

stories.title: Afyonkarahisar’da midibüs şarampole uçtu; 25 kişi yaralandı

en.title: Minibus veers off road in Afyonkarahisar; 25 people injured
en.summary: A minibus lost control and went off the road in Şuhut, Afyonkarahisar, resulting in 25 injuries.

stories.title: Afyonkarahisar'da feci kaza... Midibüs, şarampole devrildi: 25 yaralı!

en.title: Terrible accident in Afyonkarahisar... Minibus overturned off road: 25 injured
en.summary: A minibus overturned off the road in Şuhut district, Afyonkarahisar, leaving 25 people injured, with an investigation launched.

stories.title: Sosyal medya fenomeni olan zihinsel engelli şahıs darbedildi: Şüphelilerden şikayetçi oldu

en.title: Social media phenomenon with intellectual disability beaten: filed complaint against suspects
en.summary: A 40-year-old intellectually disabled man known on social media for dancing while cycling was reportedly beaten by relatives of a child after allegedly touching the child's head. He filed a complaint against the suspects after receiving medical treatment.

stories.title: Zihinsel engelli sosyal medya fenomeni darbedildi

en.title: Intellectually disabled social media phenomenon beaten
en.summary: A 40-year-old intellectually disabled man from Ceyhan district known for social media videos of dancing while cycling was beaten.

stories.title: Afyonkarahisar’da midibüs devrildi: Çok sayıda yaralı var!

en.title: Minibus overturned in Afyonkarahisar: Many injured
en.summary: A city transport minibus overturned on a roadside embankment in Afyonkarahisar, leaving approximately 25 people injured in the accident.

stories.title: Yenişehir Belediye Başkanvekili Çağdaş Dutlu oldu

en.title: Çağdaş Dutlu became Yenişehir Mayor Deputy
en.summary: Following the arrest and removal of Yenişehir Mayor Abdullah Özyiğit in Mersin, a new deputy was appointed to the position.

stories.title: Ağrı Dağı'nda korku dolu anlar: Dağcılar kaya kütlelerinden son anda kurtuldu

en.title: Terrifying moments on Mount Ararat: Climbers narrowly escaped from rock masses
en.summary: Climbers on Mount Ararat narrowly avoided being crushed by large boulders during a landslide at their 4,200-meter camp while attempting to reach the summit. One climber was recorded shouting warnings to alert others to the danger.

stories.title: Ağrı Dağı’nda heyelan: Dağcılar kayalardan son anda kurtuldu

en.title: Landslide on Mount Ararat: Climbers narrowly escaped from rocks
en.summary: Climbers on Mount Ararat narrowly avoided being crushed by large boulders during a landslide at their 4,200-meter camp while attempting to reach the summit. One climber was recorded shouting warnings to alert others to the danger.

stories.title: Havuza düşen 2 yaşındaki Hasan İsmail hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Two-year-old Hasan İsmail who fell into pool dies
en.summary: A two-year-old boy drowned after falling into water near his home in Alaplı, Zonguldak, despite medical efforts to save him at the hospital. The incident deeply affected his family and community.

stories.title: Tokat’ta salgın endişesi büyüyor: Hastaneye başvuranların sayısı yaklaşık 5 bine çıktı

en.title: Outbreak concerns growing in Tokat: Number of hospital visits reaches approximately 5,000
en.summary: About 5,000 people have sought medical treatment in Tokat with symptoms including nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and diarrhea, according to the provincial governor. The cause of the outbreak concerns remains unclear from available information.

en.title: Stock exchange closes day with decline
en.summary: Turkey's BIST 100 index fell 0.94 percent to close at 12,150.67 points, down 115.3 points from the previous close, with total trading volume reaching 81.5 billion lira.

stories.title: Erdoğan: Ekim ayı içinde 1 milyon TL'ye kadar ana para ödemelerine başlanacak

en.title: Erdoğan: Principal repayments up to 1 million TL to begin in October
en.summary: President Erdoğan announced that following parliament's approval of a fund investigation bill, principal repayments of up to 1 million lira will commence in October.

stories.title: Kulüpler Birliği’nden Süper Lig yayın ihalesine ilişkin açıklama

en.title: Clubs Association statement on Super League broadcast auction
en.summary: The Clubs Association Foundation announced that preparations for the Super League's broadcast rights auction are ongoing.

stories.title: New York borsası karışık seyirle açıldı

en.title: New York stock exchange opens with mixed trading
en.summary: The New York stock exchange opened with mixed movement on the first trading day of a week when inflation data and bank earnings will be released, with the Dow Jones index rising 0.2 percent to 51,765.35 points.

stories.title: Merkez Bankası rezervlerinde 6 hafta sonra yön değişti!

en.title: Central Bank reserves reverse direction after 6 weeks of decline
en.summary: Turkey's central bank reserves stopped declining after six weeks and are estimated to have increased by 4.2 billion dollars in one week to reach 171.6 billion dollars. Official figures will be released on October 15.
